blocks.text: O'zbekchada inkor ikki marta keladi: «**Hech kim** kel**ma**di», «**Hech narsa** de**ma**di». Bu xato emas — o'zbek tilining qoidasi. Ingliz tilida esa gapda **bitta inkor** bo'ladi: yoki fe'l inkor shaklida va undan keyin **any-** (I **didn't** see **anybody**), yoki fe'l darak shaklida va inkor **no-** so'zida (I saw **nobody**). «I didn't see nobody» kabi ikki inkor so'zlashuvda va ba'zi shevalarda eshitiladi, lekin standart ingliz tilida, imtihonda va ish yozishmasida — xato. Asoslar qizil kitobda (→ qizil kitob, 77- va 78-darslar); bu darsda — nozik holatlar va tanlov.

rows: We've got **no** time. / We **haven't** got **any** time.

blocks.text: no + ot va not any: farqi nimada?

**no** + ot = **not a** / **not any**. Ma'no bir xil, lekin **no** kuchliroq va qat'iyroq eshitiladi, ayniqsa **have (got)** va **there is / there are** bilan: There's **no** milk. Ikki joyda faqat **no** to'g'ri keladi: 1) gap **boshida**, ega oldida: **No** students passed («Not any students ...» — xato); 2) qisqa iboralar va yozuvlarda: **No** problem. **No** parking. Yana bir nozik holat: **no** + birlikdagi ot ba'zan «... emas» ma'nosini beradi: I'm **no** expert — Men mutaxassis emasman (kamtarlik bilan).

items.text: There's **no** point in waiting — the last bus has gone.
items.translation: Kutishning **foydasi yo'q** — oxirgi avtobus ketib bo'ldi.

items.text: **No** hotel in the old town had a free room that weekend.
items.translation: O'sha dam olish kunlari eski shahardagi **birorta ham** mehmonxonada bo'sh xona **yo'q edi**.

items.text: I'm **no** doctor, but that cut looks serious.
items.translation: Men **shifokor emasman**, lekin bu kesik jiddiy ko'rinyapti.

blocks.text: **none** — otsiz **no**: ot oldin aytilgan bo'lsa, uni takrorlamaslik uchun. Qisqa javobda ham keladi: How many did you buy? — **None**. Aniq guruh haqida — **none of** + the / my / these / them / us. E'tibor bering: none ko'pincha **narsalar** yoki aniq guruh uchun; odamlar haqida umuman «hech kim» deyilsa — **nobody / no-one**. **none of** + ko'plikdagi otdan keyin fe'l rasmiy uslubda **birlikda** (None of them **is** ready), so'zlashuvda ko'pincha **ko'plikda** (None of them **are** ready) — ikkalasi ham to'g'ri. Sanalmaydigan ot bilan esa faqat birlik: None of the money **was** lost.

items.text: We need eggs for the cake, but there are **none** in the fridge.
items.translation: Tort uchun tuxum kerak, lekin muzlatkichda **birorta ham yo'q**.

items.text: **None of** the photos from the wedding **are** in focus.
How many emails did you answer today? — **None** — the internet was down.
items.translation: Bugun nechta xatga javob berdingiz? — **Birortasiga ham** — internet ishlamadi.

blocks.text: nobody, nothing, nowhere — boshida va oxirida

**nobody / no-one** (hech kim), **nothing** (hech narsa), **nowhere** (hech qayer) gapning **boshida** kelsa, boshqa yo'l yo'q — faqat no- shakli: **Nothing** happened («Anything didn't happen» — xato). Gapning **oxirida** esa ikki yo'l bor: He said **nothing** yoki He **didn't** say **anything**. Ikkinchisi so'zlashuvda ko'proq uchraydi, birinchisi qat'iyroq va adabiyroq. Fe'l doim **birlikda**: Nobody **knows**, Nothing **is** ready. Lekin olmosh sifatida ko'pincha **they / them / their** ishlatiladi (he or she o'rniga): **Nobody** forgot **their** passport.

items.text: **Nobody** knows where the old map is, do **they**?
items.translation: Eski xarita qayerdaligini **hech kim** bilmaydi, to'g'rimi?

items.text: **Nothing** was stolen from the car, but the window was broken.
items.translation: Mashinadan **hech narsa** o'g'irlanmadi, lekin oynasi sindirilgan edi.
Bobom bilan buvim chet elga **hech qachon** bormagan.

blocks.text: any- yoki no-? Bir harf — boshqa ma'no

Darak gapda **any-** «istalgan, kim bo'lsa ham» degani (→ 85-dars). Shuning uchun **Anybody** can do it (Buni **har kim** qila oladi) va **Nobody** can do it (Buni **hech kim** qila olmaydi) — qarama-qarshi gaplar. «Hech kim» demoqchi bo'lsangiz, gap boshida **any-** ishlatmang: «Anybody can't do it» — xato, to'g'risi **Nobody** can do it. Xuddi shunday: I'll eat **anything** (nima bo'lsa ham yeyman) ↔ I'll eat **nothing** (hech narsa yemayman).

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I don't know nothing» → I don't know **anything** / I know **nothing**; «Anybody didn't come» → **Nobody** came; «Not any students passed» → **No** students passed; «None people came» → **No** people came / **Nobody** came (none dan keyin ot kelmaydi — faqat **none of**); «Nobody don't like it» → Nobody **likes** it (fe'l birlikda va darak shaklida).

Inkorni «bitta tanga» deb tasavvur qiling: uni yoki fe'lga beraman (didn't, can't, haven't), yoki so'zga (nobody, nothing, no) — ikkalasiga bir vaqtda emas. O'zbekcha «hech ... **-ma**» dagi «-ma» ni inglizchaga olib o'tmang.

examples.title: One negative only: **nobody** came, I **didn't** see **anyone**
examples.description: O'zbekchada «hech kim kelmadi» — ikki inkor, inglizchada esa bitta: yoki no- so'zi + darak fe'l, yoki inkor fe'l + any-.

sentences.text: **Nobody** answered the phone at the tax office all morning.
sentences.translation: Ertalabdan beri soliq idorasida telefonni **hech kim ko'tarmadi**.

sentences.text: I looked in every drawer, but I found **nothing**.
sentences.translation: Hamma tortmani qaradim, lekin **hech narsa topmadim**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **didn't** tell **anybody** about his new job.
sentences.translation: Bekzod yangi ishi haqida **hech kimga aytmadi**.

sentences.text: **Nothing** is more important to Nilufar than her family.
sentences.translation: Nilufar uchun oilasidan muhimroq **hech narsa yo'q**.

sentences.text: We **didn't** go **anywhere** last weekend because the car broke down.
sentences.translation: O'tgan dam olish kunlari mashina buzilib qolgani uchun **hech qayerga bormadik**.

sentences.text: There was **nobody** at the reception desk when we arrived at the hotel.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxonaga kelganimizda qabulxonada **hech kim yo'q edi**.

sentences.text: **No-one** in my family can swim, so we never go to the beach.
sentences.translation: Oilamizda **hech kim** suzishni **bilmaydi**, shuning uchun hech qachon plyajga bormaymiz.

sentences.text: I've got **nothing** to wear to my cousin's wedding!
sentences.translation: Amakivachchamning to'yiga kiyishga **hech narsam yo'q**!

sentences.text: The police searched the flat, but they **didn't** find **anything** suspicious.
sentences.translation: Politsiya kvartirani tintuv qildi, lekin **hech qanday** shubhali narsa **topmadi**.

sentences.text: Sarah went **nowhere** during the holidays — she stayed at home and revised.
sentences.translation: Sara ta'til davomida **hech qayerga bormadi** — uyda qolib, darslarini takrorladi.

examples.title: **no** + noun: There's **no** time, I'm **no** expert
examples.description: no + ot = not any / not a, lekin kuchliroq. Gap boshida faqat no bo'ladi. I'm no expert — «men mutaxassis emasman» (kamtarlik).

sentences.text: Hurry up — there's **no** time for breakfast this morning.
sentences.translation: Shoshil — bugun ertalab nonushtaga **vaqt yo'q**.

sentences.text: Sorry, we've got **no** rooms left for tonight.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, bugun tunga **bo'sh xonamiz qolmadi**.

sentences.text: **No** students failed the exam this year — the teacher was delighted.
sentences.translation: Bu yil imtihondan **hech bir talaba yiqilmadi** — o'qituvchi juda xursand bo'ldi.

sentences.text: There are **no** buses after midnight in our village, so we have to take a taxi.
sentences.translation: Qishlog'imizda yarim tundan keyin **avtobus yo'q**, shuning uchun taksi olishga majburmiz.

sentences.text: Jasur has **no** idea how to fix the washing machine.
sentences.translation: Jasurda kir yuvish mashinasini qanday tuzatish haqida **hech qanday tasavvur yo'q**.

sentences.text: I'm **no** expert, but I think your computer needs more memory.
sentences.translation: Men **mutaxassis emasman**, lekin menimcha kompyuteringizga ko'proq xotira kerak.

sentences.text: There's **no** need to book in advance — the museum is never crowded.
sentences.translation: Oldindan joy band qilishga **hojat yo'q** — muzey hech qachon gavjum bo'lmaydi.

sentences.text: The shop had **no** milk, so I bought some juice instead.
sentences.translation: Do'konda **sut yo'q edi**, shuning uchun o'rniga sharbat oldim.

sentences.text: **No** smoking is allowed anywhere on the hospital grounds.
sentences.translation: Shifoxona hududining hech bir joyida **chekish mumkin emas**.

sentences.text: Emma moved to Edinburgh with **no** job and **no** friends, but within a year she had both.
sentences.translation: Emma Edinburgga **na ishi, na do'stlari** bo'lmagan holda ko'chib bordi, lekin bir yil ichida ikkalasiga ham ega bo'ldi.

examples.title: **none**: without a noun and in short answers
examples.description: none — ot takrorlanmasligi uchun (= no + ot). Qisqa javobda ham: How many ...? — None. Odamlar haqida umuman «hech kim» — nobody / no-one.

sentences.text: I wanted some cherries, but there were **none** left at the market.
sentences.translation: Gilos olmoqchi edim, lekin bozorda **birorta ham qolmagan** ekan.

sentences.text: How many mistakes did you make in the test? — **None**!
sentences.translation: Testda nechta xato qildingiz? — **Bitta ham qilmadim**!

sentences.text: Kate asked for more coffee, but there was **none** in the pot.
sentences.translation: Keyt yana qahva so'radi, lekin qahvadonda **umuman qolmagan edi**.

sentences.text: We expected lots of complaints about the new system, but we got **none**.
sentences.translation: Yangi tizim haqida ko'p shikoyat kutgandik, lekin **birorta ham** kelmadi.

sentences.text: How much sugar do you take? — **None**, thanks — I'm trying to cut down.
sentences.translation: Necha qoshiq shakar solasiz? — **Umuman solmayman**, rahmat — kamaytirishga harakat qilyapman.

sentences.text: Madina has three brothers, but I have **none**.
sentences.translation: Madinaning uchta aka-ukasi bor, mening esa **birorta ham yo'q**.

sentences.text: He promised to send me photos from the trip, but **none** have arrived yet.
sentences.translation: U sayohatdan suratlar yuborishga va'da bergan edi, lekin hali **birortasi ham kelmadi**.

sentences.text: Any letters for me today? — No, **none** at all, I'm afraid.
sentences.translation: Bugun menga xat bormi? — Yo'q, afsuski, **birorta ham yo'q**.

sentences.text: Oliver needed an umbrella, but I had **none** to lend him.
sentences.translation: Oliverga soyabon kerak edi, lekin menda unga beradigan **birorta ham yo'q edi**.

sentences.text: Tickets for the final sold out in an hour, and fans who came late got **none**.
sentences.translation: Final chiptalari bir soatda sotilib ketdi, kech qolgan muxlislarga **birortasi ham tegmadi**.

examples.title: **none of** the / my / them + verb
examples.description: none of + the / my / these / them / us. Fe'l: rasmiy uslubda birlik (none of them is), so'zlashuvda ko'pincha ko'plik (none of them are). Sanalmaydigan ot bilan — faqat birlik.

sentences.text: **None of** my friends **knew** about the party until the last minute.
sentences.translation: Do'stlarimning **hech biri** ziyofat haqida oxirgi daqiqagacha **bilmadi**.

sentences.text: Unfortunately, **none of** these batteries **works**, so we need new ones.
sentences.translation: Afsuski, bu batareyalarning **birortasi ham ishlamaydi**, shuning uchun yangisi kerak.

sentences.text: We interviewed six candidates, but **none of them were** suitable for the job.
sentences.translation: Oltita nomzod bilan suhbat o'tkazdik, lekin **ularning hech biri** bu ishga **to'g'ri kelmadi**.

sentences.text: Aziz has read three books by this author, but he understood **none of them**.
sentences.translation: Aziz bu muallifning uchta kitobini o'qidi, lekin **birortasini ham tushunmadi**.

sentences.text: Sadly, **none of** the money **was** spent on the new school.
sentences.translation: Afsuski, pulning **hech bir qismi** yangi maktabga **sarflanmadi**.

sentences.text: Thankfully, **none of us was** hurt when the bus hit the barrier.
sentences.translation: Xayriyatki, avtobus to'siqqa urilganda **hech birimiz jarohat olmadik**.

sentences.text: How much I earn is **none of your business**!
sentences.translation: Qancha topishim **sizning ishingiz emas**!

sentences.text: In our group, **none of** the students **have** been to London before.
sentences.translation: Guruhimizdagi talabalarning **hech biri** ilgari Londonda **bo'lmagan**.

sentences.text: **None of** the dishes at the wedding **were** vegetarian, so Kate ate only bread and salad.
sentences.translation: To'ydagi taomlarning **hech biri** vegetarian **emas edi**, shuning uchun Keyt faqat non va salat yedi.

sentences.text: I've emailed five hotels in Bukhara, and **none of them has** replied yet.
sentences.translation: Buxorodagi beshta mehmonxonaga xat yozdim, lekin **ularning hech biri** hali **javob bermadi**.

examples.title: **nobody** / **no-one** + they, them, their
examples.description: nobody, no-one, anybody, somebody, everybody dan keyin olmosh sifatida ko'pincha they / them / their keladi (he or she o'rniga). Fe'l esa birlikda: Nobody knows.

sentences.text: **Nobody** phoned while I was at lunch, did **they**?
sentences.translation: Men tushlikda bo'lganimda **hech kim** qo'ng'iroq qilmadi, shundaymi?

sentences.text: **No-one** has finished **their** homework, so the test is postponed.
sentences.translation: **Hech kim** uy vazifasini tugatmagan, shuning uchun test keyinga qoldirildi.

sentences.text: If **anybody** calls, tell **them** I'll be back at three.
sentences.translation: Agar **kimdir** qo'ng'iroq qilsa, **unga** soat uchda qaytishimni ayting.

sentences.text: **Nobody** likes being criticised in front of **their** colleagues.
sentences.translation: **Hech kim** **o'z** hamkasblari oldida tanqid qilinishni yoqtirmaydi.

sentences.text: **Someone** has left **their** umbrella in the meeting room.
sentences.translation: **Kimdir** majlislar xonasida **o'z** soyabonini qoldirib ketibdi.

sentences.text: When the fire alarm went off, **nobody** knew where **they** should go.
sentences.translation: Yong'in signali chalinganda **hech kim** qayerga borish kerakligini **bilmadi**.

sentences.text: **Everybody** in the team did **their** best, but we still lost the match.
sentences.translation: Jamoada **har kim** **qo'lidan kelganini** qildi, lekin baribir o'yinda yutqazdik.

sentences.text: **Nobody** at the party recognised Dilnoza with her new short hair.
sentences.translation: Ziyofatda Dilnozani yangi kalta sochi bilan **hech kim tanimadi**.

sentences.text: There's **no-one** here who speaks French, I'm afraid.
sentences.translation: Afsuski, bu yerda fransuzcha gapiradigan **hech kim yo'q**.

sentences.text: The manager asked if **anyone** had any questions, but **no-one** said a word.
sentences.translation: Menejer **kimdadir** savol bor-yo'qligini so'radi, lekin **hech kim** churq etmadi.

examples.title: Two ways: said **nothing** / **didn't** say **anything**
examples.description: Inkorning ikki yo'li: not + any- (so'zlashuvda ko'proq) yoki no- (qat'iyroq). Ma'no bir xil, lekin ikkalasini birga ishlatib bo'lmaydi. Gap boshida — faqat no-.

sentences.text: Bekzod **said nothing** about the accident when he got home.
sentences.translation: Bekzod uyga kelganida avariya haqida **hech narsa demadi**.

sentences.text: His wife **didn't** notice **anything** strange until the next morning.
sentences.translation: Xotini ertasi tonggacha **hech qanday** g'alati narsani **sezmadi**.

sentences.text: There's **nothing** on TV tonight, so let's go for a walk.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun televizorda **hech narsa yo'q**, keling, sayr qilamiz.

sentences.text: I **don't** know **anyone** in Oxford, so I'll stay in a hotel.
sentences.translation: Oksfordda **hech kimni tanimayman**, shuning uchun mehmonxonada qolaman.

sentences.text: **Nowhere** in the city centre is open after eleven on weekdays.
sentences.translation: Ish kunlari soat o'n birdan keyin shahar markazida **hech qayer ochiq emas**.

sentences.text: Kate **didn't** buy **anything** in the sales — everything was still too expensive.
sentences.translation: Keyt chegirmalarda **hech narsa sotib olmadi** — hammasi baribir juda qimmat edi.

sentences.text: **Nothing** happened for hours, and then suddenly the whole street lost power.
sentences.translation: Bir necha soat **hech narsa bo'lmadi**, keyin to'satdan butun ko'chada tok o'chdi.

sentences.text: The witness **saw nobody** leave the building that night.
sentences.translation: Guvoh o'sha kechasi binodan **hech kimning** chiqqanini **ko'rmadi**.

sentences.text: There **isn't anything** we can do now — the decision has been made.
sentences.translation: Endi qila oladigan **hech narsamiz yo'q** — qaror qabul qilib bo'lingan.

sentences.text: I've **got nothing** against your plan, but I **don't** have **any** time to help.
sentences.translation: Rejangizga **hech qanday e'tirozim yo'q**, lekin yordam berishga **umuman vaqtim yo'q**.

examples.title: **anybody** or **nobody**? **any** or **no**?
examples.description: Darak gapda anybody / anything / any — «kim bo'lsa ham, istalgan»; nobody / nothing / no — «hech kim, hech narsa». Bir bo'g'in farqi ma'noni butunlay o'zgartiradi.

sentences.text: **Anybody** can learn to cook plov — it just takes practice.
sentences.translation: Palov damlashni **har kim** o'rganishi mumkin — faqat mashq kerak.

sentences.text: **Nobody** can cook plov like my grandmother.
sentences.translation: Buvimdek palov damlashni **hech kim** eplay olmaydi.

sentences.text: I'm not fussy — I'll eat **anything** except fish.
sentences.translation: Tanlab o'tirmayman — baliqdan boshqa **hamma narsani** yeyman.

sentences.text: My little son is very fussy and eats **nothing** green.
sentences.translation: Kichkina o'g'lim juda injiq, ko'k rangli **hech narsani yemaydi**.

sentences.text: You can park **anywhere** on this street after six o'clock.
sentences.translation: Soat oltidan keyin bu ko'chaning **istalgan joyida** mashina qo'yishingiz mumkin.

sentences.text: There's **nowhere** to park near the hospital, so take the metro.
sentences.translation: Shifoxona yaqinida mashina qo'yadigan **joy yo'q**, shuning uchun metroda boring.

sentences.text: **Any** computer in the library can print in colour.
sentences.translation: Kutubxonadagi **istalgan** kompyuter rangli chop eta oladi.

sentences.text: **No** computer in the lab could open the old files, so we lost the data.
sentences.translation: Laboratoriyadagi **birorta ham** kompyuter eski fayllarni **ocha olmadi**, shuning uchun ma'lumotlarni yo'qotdik.

sentences.text: Is **anybody** sitting here? — No, **nobody**. Please take a seat.
sentences.translation: Bu yerda **kimdir** o'tiribdimi? — Yo'q, **hech kim**. Marhamat, o'tiring.

sentences.text: James says he's afraid of **nothing**, but I know he's terrified of spiders.
sentences.translation: Jeyms **hech narsadan qo'rqmasligini** aytadi, lekin men uning o'rgimchakdan dahshat qo'rqishini bilaman.

examples.title: Dialogue: lost luggage at the airport
examples.description: Aeroportda yo'qolgan yuk haqida suhbat: no, none of, nothing, nobody, no-one — har gapda bitta inkor.

sentences.text: — Excuse me, my suitcase hasn't come out, and there's **nobody** at the information desk.
sentences.translation: — Kechirasiz, chamadonim chiqmadi, ma'lumot bo'limida esa **hech kim yo'q**.

sentences.text: — Sorry about that. Which flight were you on, and have you got **any** documents for the bag?
sentences.translation: — Uzr. Qaysi reysda uchdingiz va chamadon uchun **biror** hujjatingiz bormi?

sentences.text: — The flight from London, but I've got **no** baggage tag — I must have thrown it away.
sentences.translation: — London reysida, lekin menda **bagaj birkasi yo'q** — tashlab yuborgan bo'lsam kerak.

sentences.text: — **No** problem, I can find your name in the system. Let me check.
sentences.translation: — **Muammo yo'q**, ismingizni tizimdan topa olaman. Hozir tekshiraman.

sentences.text: — Thanks. All my clothes are in it, and I've got **nothing** for tomorrow's meeting.
sentences.translation: — Rahmat. Hamma kiyimlarim o'shanda, ertangi uchrashuv uchun **hech narsam yo'q**.

sentences.text: — Well, **none of** the bags from your flight stayed in London, so that's good news.
sentences.translation: — Xo'sh, reysingizdagi chamadonlarning **hech biri** Londonda qolmagan, bu yaxshi xabar.

sentences.text: — But **nobody** has seen mine, and there's **nothing** with my name on it here!
sentences.translation: — Lekin meninkini **hech kim** ko'rmagan, bu yerda ismim yozilgan **hech narsa yo'q**!

sentences.text: — Wait, there's one black case that **no-one** has collected yet. Is it yours?
sentences.translation: — Shoshmang, **hech kim** olib ketmagan bitta qora chamadon bor. Sizniki emasmi?

sentences.text: — Yes, that's mine! I **didn't** look **anywhere** near that corner.
sentences.translation: — Ha, o'sha meniki! O'sha burchak tomonga **umuman qaramagan** ekanman.

sentences.text: — Then there's **no** need to fill in the form. Enjoy your stay in Tashkent!
sentences.translation: — Unda anketa to'ldirishga **hojat yo'q**. Toshkentda yaxshi dam oling!
